hooks.command:
python -c "import json,sys,subprocess,os
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
f=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath')
ruff=os.path.join('.venv','Scripts','ruff.exe')
if f and f.endswith('.py'):
    subprocess.run([ruff,'check','--fix','--select','I','--quiet',f])
    subprocess.run([ruff,'format','--quiet',f])" 2>/dev/null || true

python -c "import json,sys,subprocess
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
f=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath')
parts=(f or '').replace(chr(92),'/').split('/')
if f and f.endswith('.py') and 'schemas' in parts and parts[-1] != '__init__.py':
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/generate_schemas_init.py'])" 2>/dev/null || true
